name: cloudflare_access
label: Cloudflare Access Auth
description: Dashboard auth provider that trusts the Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion header / CF_Authorization cookie set by Cloudflare Zero Trust. Routes mount under /api/plugins/cloudflare_access/ — the public path the dashboard-auth middleware allows the plugin to register its own callback. See the dashboard_auth/cloudflare_access/ plugin for the auth provider registration.
